text:
Asha: Kicking off the sales/partnerships slot from today’s all-hands — drop any clarifying Qs about pipeline, GTM focus, or partner updates and we’ll answer live.
Tom (Head of GTM): Happy to take GTM + pipeline questions here.
Priya (Sales Ops): Quick ask — can leadership confirm the FYQ2 ARR target we called out on slides? My deck needs the final number for regional leaders.
Asha: FYQ2 ARR target: $4.2M net new ARR (company-wide). We’ll share the slide deck update after this thread.
Ben (Partnerships): On partnerships — are we prioritizing ISV marketplace listings (cloud marketplaces) or direct channel resale for the next 90 days?
Tom (Head of GTM): Short answer: both, but sequencing matters. Next 30 days focus = 1) Marketplace listing enablement with AWS/GCP partner teams (fast discovery), 2) top-tier ISV integrations for co-sell pilots (next 60–90 days).
Priya (Sales Ops): For forecasting: what are the key conversion metrics we should be tracking for the deck? SQL -> Demo -> Pilot -> Closed. Any target %s?
Asha: Good call. Use these targets for leadership decks: SQL->Demo 45%, Demo->Pilot 28%, Pilot->Closed 35%. These are aspirational but align with current top-rep performance.
Emma (Product): On pilot sizing — should engineering commit to 2 dedicated demo GPUs for high-touch pilots or do we expect Dedicated capacity trials to be elastic?
Tom (Head of GTM): For strategic pilots (enterprise+ISV), commit 2 dedicated demo GPUs for the pilot duration. For smaller customers use hosted with burst credits.
Ben (Partnerships): Anything about co-sell economics? Do we offer margin splits or co-fund dev/integration credits?
Asha: Initially offer co-sell referral credits and dev/integration credits for strategic partners. We’ll pilot 15% referral credit + up to $30k co-fund for integration on a case-by-case basis — measure ROI after Q2.
Priya (Sales Ops): Who’s owner for partner onboarding checklist? I can add it to the GTM playbook but need a single owner for approvals.
Ben (Partnerships): I’ll own the onboarding checklist and run a weekly sync with Sales Ops to finalize the checklist this Thursday.
DevBot: Agenda doc updated: https://internal.redwood/gtm/partnerships/onboarding (edited)
Tom (Head of GTM): Follow-up action: I’ll update the pipeline slides with Asha’s target and conversion rates by EOD. @Priya can you run the region-level model and share variance analysis tomorrow?
Priya (Sales Ops): Yep — will have region-level variance and top 15 accounts that drive the delta by noon.
Emma (Product): Requesting a partner feature-priority slot: we need partner-facing API keys and a simplified usage dashboard by mid-Q2 to reduce integration friction.
Asha: Noted. Product + Partnerships coordinate on the roadmap. @Emma please add acceptance criteria and expected telemetry so we can measure adoption.
Ben (Partnerships): Also, quick ask for sales: map any accounts where a partner already has relationships. Can SalesOps share an import template?
Priya (Sales Ops): Sharing template now: `csv` with columns: partner_name, partner_contact, account_name, account_owner, existing_relationship_notes.
Tom (Head of GTM): One more ask from execs: any blockers on expanding Dedicated capacity for pilot customers next month?
Emma (Product): Main blocker = capacity automation for ephemeral pilot nodes. Engineering has a backlog item; I’ll escalate.
Asha: OK — if engineering needs a formal exec ask, post it here with the ETA. We want no more than a 2-week runway on the capacity automation ticket.
Ben (Partnerships): Thanks — I’ll also line up partner product contacts so pilots can start as soon as capacity is available.
Tom (Head of GTM): Closing note — we’re targeting a partner-led pilot kickoff window between May 10–24. If any team cannot meet dependencies, flag in this thread.
Priya (Sales Ops): Flagged for APAC demo scheduling — need localized demo owners. Looping @Sara to help with AMs.
Asha: Appreciate everyone. I’ll post the slide update + a short follow-up doc after this thread. :thumbsup:
Ben (Partnerships): :raised_hands: thanks all — I’ll send the onboarding draft by Thurs EOD.
DevBot: Thread marked as "follow-up needed" and assigned to Ben, Priya, Tom.
